units: pt (1/72 in) unless stated; coordinates top-left origin

body_size.method: character-weighted most common font size (0.5 pt bins)

heading_hierarchy.method: multi-line ≤3 blocks ≥1.15× body size, sizes clustered within 0.6 pt, ≥2 occurrences, ordered by size

line_spacing_body.method: median of per-page baseline-distance ratios at body size

margins_body_median.method: median body-text margins (running headers/footers excluded) over pages with ≥200 characters

margins_text_median.method: median margins of all text incl. running headers/footers

running_elements.method: top/bottom-band lines repeated on ≥50 % of pages (digits normalised)

facing_pages.method: odd/even margins not mirrored (or <4 text pages)

spreads.method: landscape pages ~2 portrait pages wide with no text across the centre

columns.method: pages by body column count (high/medium confidence pages only)

alignment.method: body blocks by direction and alignment

accent_colors.method: saturated colours used in text, fills or rules on ≥2 pages

rules.method: thin horizontal drawing paths

tables.method: ruled tables (find_tables lines strategy)

images.method: image placements; caption = smaller-than-body text within 24 pt

vector_graphics.method: clusters of drawing paths (possible charts/diagrams)
